plan.notes: Official four-year plan page from Seattle University (College of Science and Engineering), 2026-2027. Quarter-Based Degree Plan transcribed. Lecture+lab bundles split into their real course codes at the published split credits. The CHEM 1520 (4) / CHEM 1590 (5) choice transcribed at 4 cr; MATH 1028 Trigonometry (2 cr, only if needed) transcribed as a 0-cr choice slot. Quarter sums: 16/16/14/16/16/16/15/15/15/16/15/10 = 180, matching the minimum to graduate. Curriculum notes: at least 25 cr of BIOL elective credits at 3000/4000 level; BIOL electives (BIOL 2210+) must include one project-lab course (BIOL 3750/3760/3770) and one medical/micro course (BIOL 4100/4150/4700); C- or better required in prerequisite BIOL/CHEM/MATH. Retrieved 2026-10-09.
